How To Create Subdomain

Home » How To Create Subdomain

 

As an MW Hoster web hosting customer, you can create subdomains (separately from your main domain) in the Sub domains function in MW Panel. For example, if you have a Blog for your site, you can create a subdomain called “Blog” and the address would be “blog.example.com”

 

1. Login into your MW Panel.
2. Goto your Domain Names and click on “Subdomains”.

 

 

 

 

 

 

3. Type in the name of the subdomain and select the domain to create it under. It will automatically create a folder for the subdomain in your public_html folder and click on Create Subdomain.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

Note:It can take up to 24 hours for a new Subdomain to propagate (show up on the web).

Congratulations, you have added your first subdomain!
